mediaWork.title: The Carrollton Plot (Dateline NBC)
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: Disputed forensic evidence (blood spatter), potential staging of crime scene, possible financial motive in a murder case
mediaWork.summaryNotes: Investigation into controversial conviction of Darlie Routier; disputed blood evidence; media portrayal; maintains innocence on death row. Available via NBC/Peacock.

mediaItem.focusOrTheme: Disputed forensic evidence (blood spatter), potential staging of crime scene, possible financial motive in a murder case
mediaItem.summaryNotes: While the specific episode title "The Carrollton Plot" wasn't confirmed [cite: 1.1], the Darlie Routier case has received significant media coverage, including likely by Dateline. Key points of contention include the interpretation of forensic evidence like blood spatter, the plausibility of the intruder story versus staging, and the debated financial motive [cite: 2.1, 10.1]. Ongoing DNA testing highlights the persistent questions surrounding the case [cite: 10.1].
